description: This file contains the unit tests for the GatewaySession class, focusing on connection logic, token handling, invoke request handling, and capabilities refresh within the Android app environment. It uses Kotlin coroutines, MockWebServer, and Robolectric for testing.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that stores tokens in memory for testing purposes.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class encapsulating a GatewaySession, its Job, and a device auth store for test setups.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: A data class holding the request object and the JSON result of an invoke scenario.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Test class containing multiple unit tests for GatewaySession connection, token handling, and invoke request processing.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Creates a Json instance with ignoreUnknownKeys=true for parsing test JSON data.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Sets up a NodeHarness with a Callback for invoke requests and connection synchronization.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Connects the GatewaySession to a server endpoint with specified tokens.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for connection to be established within a timeout, throws if not connected.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up resources for a test harness, disconnecting session and shutting down server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Simulates an invoke scenario with server interactions, returning request and result details.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Builds a JSON string representing a server response frame with optional URL and auth info.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Starts a mock web server configured to handle WebSocket requests for testing.
